newsitem.title: USA: Tapistron files reorganization with court.
newsitem.headline: Tapistron files reorganization with court.

text.p: Tapistron International Inc said on Monday it has filed a plan of reorganization with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court.
Tapistron, which filed Chapter 11 in June and was later delisted from the Nasdaq, also said it has entered an investment banking agreement with Avonwood Capital Corp to complete the reorganization.

Under the agreement, Avonwood will advise and assist Tapistron with its efforts to raise a total of $2.5 million to implement its Plan of Reorganization and to re-capitalize the company, Tapistron said.

Tapistron also said it has entered into an agreement with Avonwood, pursuant to which Avonwood will assist Tapistron in obtaining a $500,000 credit facility to provide Tapistron with working capital, pending confirmation of Tapistron's Plan of Reorganization.
